audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Gragas or Skill every row (win[] and phases[].side), while every why/spike text under it describes Fiora winning, and the packet chart says Fiora for rows 1-6 and Skill at 2+ items.
audit.why: 48.36% over 304 games with Riposte answering the single cast Gragas's all-in depends on. The mirror audit (fiora__gragas) already fixed this chart to Fiora through First item, Skill at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through First item -> Fiora; 2+ items -> Skill, flipped as one atomic group across both layers.

audit.why: Spikes already key off Lvl 2-3, Lvl 6, 1st item and Fiora's counter-window, and match the kit cooldowns: Barrel Roll 10/9/8/7/6s at 80 mana, Body Slam 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Explosive Cask 100/85/70s; Riposte 24/22/20/18/16s, Grand Challenge 110/90/70s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer repeats the vague 'Parries your combo' for Riposte and never states the decisive detail: Riposte blocks ALL incoming damage and, if it blocks an immobilizing effect, it stuns instead of slows — so leading with Body Slam's stun into a live Riposte hands Fiora the stun.
audit.why: Riot text: 'stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.' Body Slam is Gragas's only engage and carries hardCC, making it the exact cast that upgrades her parry to a stun.
audit.corrected: Riposte blocks all damage and stuns you if it eats Body Slam — bait it on its 24/22/20/18/16s cooldown, then commit E-W-Q.

edits.before: Parries your combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Riposte blocks all damage and stuns you if it eats Body Slam. Bait it first.

edits.before: Track Fiora's Riposte: Parries your combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-Q burst her.
edits.after: Riposte blocks all damage and stuns you if it eats Body Slam — bait it, then E-W-Q burst.

notes: Level chart was inverted against its own explanatory text, the packet chart and the already-audited mirror; flipped as one atomic group in both layers. Ratings left untouched so the two directions cannot disagree. Fiora's Riposte->stun upgrade off Body Slam is the decisive interaction and was only stated in the content layer, never in the full layer.
